command.description: The main command: a (add), d (delete), i (integrity test), p (pipe extraction), t (table of contents), v (verbose table), x (extract)

modifiers.description: Modifiers for the command (e.g. 'ar' for add recursive, 'xe' for extract preserving types). Can also be space-separated flags like '-c -e'.

archive.description: The path to the NuFX archive file (.SHK, .BXY, .SEA, etc.)

files.description: List of specific files to add, delete, extract, or test. If empty, the command applies to all files in the archive (or current directory when adding). Use '*' for globbing if the shell handles it, or list explicitly.
